geometry: A 14 by 14 translucent black rounded rectangle with a light, 1.15-unit stroked symmetric exponential wave. The wave rises from approximately (2.5, 10.55) to (7, 3.4), then descends to (11.5, 10.55), using two smooth cubic curves and square-ended strokes.
limitations: The wave is a smooth geometric interpretation of the small antialiased original; exact pixel coverage and subtle left-right differences are not reproduced. The SVG rendering was inspected at 8x.
